note: Extra source details for the vehicle catalog.
sensor_load_included: true = cited endurance includes the stated standard sensor/payload demand; false = mission payload demand is separate from the cited endurance condition.

REMUS 100B - 1.5 kWh.sensor_load_basis: Bathymetric variant with its mission sensor configuration; treat the published endurance as sensor-inclusive.
REMUS 100B - 1.5 kWh.source_note: HII REMUS 100B bathymetric variant: 1.5 kWh, 8 h estimated endurance, up to 4.5 kt.

REMUS 130 - 1.5 kWh.sensor_load_basis: HII states the published endurance is measured at 3.0 kn with standard sensors active. Optional mission payloads are separate.
REMUS 130 - 1.5 kWh.source_note: HII REMUS 130: 1.5 kWh, 10 h at 3 kn with standard sensors active; 6 h in-vehicle recharge.

REMUS 300 - 1.5 kWh.sensor_load_basis: HII states the published endurance is measured at 3.0 kn with standard sensors active. Optional mission payloads are separate.
REMUS 300 - 1.5 kWh.source_note: HII REMUS 300 1.5-kWh configuration: 10 h at 3 kn with standard sensors active; 6 h in-vehicle recharge.

REMUS 300 - 3.0 kWh.sensor_load_basis: HII states the published endurance is measured at 3.0 kn with standard sensors active. Optional mission payloads are separate.
REMUS 300 - 3.0 kWh.source_note: HII REMUS 300 3.0-kWh standard configuration: 20 h at 3 kn with standard sensors active; 12 h in-vehicle recharge.

REMUS 300 - 4.5 kWh.sensor_load_basis: HII states the published endurance is measured at 3.0 kn with standard sensors active. Optional mission payloads are separate.
REMUS 300 - 4.5 kWh.source_note: HII REMUS 300 4.5-kWh configuration: 30 h at 3 kn with standard sensors active; 18 h in-vehicle recharge.

REMUS 600 - 5.2 kWh.sensor_load_basis: Endurance varies with battery, speed, and sensor use; the selected catalog value is treated as the vehicle baseline and mission equipment is added separately.
REMUS 600 - 5.2 kWh.source_note: HII REMUS 600 standard 5.2-kWh rechargeable configuration with the cited 24-h planning baseline. Recharge is a 4 h/kWh planning estimate.

REMUS 620 - 1 battery / no payload.sensor_load_basis: HII states this configuration for ideal conditions with no payload, so mission equipment is not included.
REMUS 620 - 1 battery / no payload.source_note: HII REMUS 620 1-battery/no-payload condition: 9.6 kWh, 42 h, 204 km, ideal conditions at approximately 2.5-3 kt.

REMUS 620 - 1 battery / MINSAS 120.sensor_load_basis: HII publishes this endurance for the example Kraken Aquapix MINSAS 120 wet-payload configuration.
REMUS 620 - 1 battery / MINSAS 120.source_note: HII REMUS 620, 1 battery with example Kraken Aquapix MINSAS 120 wet payload: 9.6 kWh, 26 h, 130 km.

REMUS 620 - 2 batteries / no payload.sensor_load_basis: HII states this configuration for ideal conditions with no payload, so mission equipment is not included.
REMUS 620 - 2 batteries / no payload.source_note: HII REMUS 620 2-battery/no-payload condition: 19.3 kWh, 80 h, 370 km, ideal conditions at approximately 2.5-3 kt.

REMUS 620 - 2 batteries / MINSAS 120.sensor_load_basis: HII publishes this endurance for the example Kraken Aquapix MINSAS 120 wet-payload configuration.
REMUS 620 - 2 batteries / MINSAS 120.source_note: HII REMUS 620, 2 batteries with example Kraken Aquapix MINSAS 120 wet payload: 19.3 kWh, 50 h, 245 km.

REMUS 620 - 3 batteries / no payload.sensor_load_basis: HII states this configuration for ideal conditions with no payload, so mission equipment is not included.
REMUS 620 - 3 batteries / no payload.source_note: HII REMUS 620 3-battery/no-payload condition: 28.9 kWh, 110 h, 509 km, ideal conditions at approximately 2.5-3 kt.

REMUS 6000 - 17.55 kWh.sensor_load_basis: Configurable payload architecture; the catalog endurance is treated as a vehicle/runtime baseline and mission equipment is added separately.
REMUS 6000 - 17.55 kWh.source_note: HII REMUS 6000: up to 17.55 kWh, up to 25 h, speeds up to 4.2 kt. Nominal 3 kt used for the planning catalog; recharge is a 4 h/kWh estimate.

Bluefin-9 - 1.9 kWh.sensor_load_basis: Modular payload vehicle; the published endurance is treated as the vehicle baseline and mission equipment is added separately.
Bluefin-9 - 1.9 kWh.source_note: General Dynamics Bluefin-9: 1.9 kWh, 8 h at 3 kt, up to 5 kt. Recharge is a 4 h/kWh estimate.

Bluefin-12 - 7.6 kWh.sensor_load_basis: Modular payload vehicle; the published speed/endurance condition is treated as the vehicle baseline and mission equipment is added separately.
Bluefin-12 - 7.6 kWh.source_note: General Dynamics Bluefin-12: 7.6 kWh; 24 h at 3 kt selected as the catalog baseline. The 36-h at 2-kt point remains reference data. Recharge is a 4 h/kWh estimate.

Bluefin-21 - 13.5 kWh.sensor_load_basis: The 25-h endurance condition is explicitly stated with the standard payload.
Bluefin-21 - 13.5 kWh.source_note: General Dynamics Bluefin-21: 13.5 kWh, 25 h at 3 kt with standard payload, up to 4.5 kt. Recharge is a 4 h/kWh estimate.

Iver3 580 Standard - 0.8 kWh.sensor_load_basis: Payload/current-dependent endurance; use the catalog value as the vehicle baseline and add the selected mission-equipment demand separately.
Iver3 580 Standard - 0.8 kWh.source_note: L3Harris Iver3 580 Standard: 0.8 kWh, 5-6 h at 2.5 kt, payload/current dependent. The 5-h endpoint is used as the conservative catalog baseline.

Iver3 EP - 0.8 kWh.sensor_load_basis: Open/configurable payload vehicle; use the catalog value as the vehicle baseline and add mission-equipment demand separately.
Iver3 EP - 0.8 kWh.source_note: L3Harris Iver3 EP: 0.8 kWh, 8-14 h at 2.5 kt. The 8-h endpoint is used as the conservative catalog baseline.

Iver4 580 - 0.78 kWh.sensor_load_basis: Configurable payload vehicle; use the catalog value as the vehicle baseline and add mission-equipment demand separately.
Iver4 580 - 0.78 kWh.source_note: L3Harris Iver4 580: 0.78 kWh, 6 h, up to 4.5 kt survey and above 5 kt sprint. Recharge is a 4 h/kWh estimate.

Iver4 900 - 2.0 kWh NiMH.sensor_load_basis: Configurable payload vehicle; use the catalog value as the vehicle baseline and add mission-equipment demand separately.
Iver4 900 - 2.0 kWh NiMH.source_note: L3Harris Iver4 900 standard NiMH configuration: 2 kWh and 20+ h. Recharge is a 4 h/kWh planning estimate.

Iver4 900 - 4.0 kWh Li-ion.sensor_load_basis: Configurable payload vehicle; use the catalog value as the vehicle baseline and add mission-equipment demand separately.
Iver4 900 - 4.0 kWh Li-ion.source_note: L3Harris Iver4 900 Li-ion: 4 kWh and 40+ h. Recharge is a 4 h/kWh estimate.

Sentry - 13 kWh validation profile.sensor_load_basis: The published endurance is mission-dependent rather than tied to one fixed sensor-duty condition; the validation retains the generic mission-equipment term.
Sentry - 13 kWh validation profile.source_note: WHOI Sentry 13-kWh validation profile uses the conservative 18-h endpoint of the published 18-40 h range. Nominal 1.2 kt is a validation-profile value based on the field missions, not a manufacturer cruise-speed claim.

Sentry - 18 kWh validation profile.sensor_load_basis: The published endurance is mission-dependent rather than tied to one fixed sensor-duty condition; the validation retains the generic mission-equipment term.
Sentry - 18 kWh validation profile.source_note: WHOI Sentry 18-kWh validation profile uses the conservative 26-h endpoint of the published 26-60 h on-bottom range. Nominal 1.2 kt is a validation-profile value based on the field missions.

Autosub5 - 25 kWh validation profile.sensor_load_basis: The cited 24-h statement explicitly says all sensors operating.
Autosub5 - 25 kWh validation profile.source_note: NOC Autosub5 validation profile: five 5-kWh batteries and approximately 24 h with all sensors operating. Nominal 2.5 kt and 3.0-kt planning max are validation-profile values based on JC237 mission speeds. Recharge is a 4 h/kWh estimate.

GEOMAR ABYSS - 11.2 kWh.sensor_load_basis: GEOMAR ties the 20-h endurance condition directly to the sidescan-sonar configuration.
GEOMAR ABYSS - 11.2 kWh.source_note: GEOMAR ABYSS: two 5.6-kWh Li-ion batteries (11.2 kWh total), 2.5-3.5 kt, up to 20 h with sidescan sonar and up to 16 h with multibeam sonar. The 20-h sidescan condition is used here. Recharge is a 4 h/kWh estimate.

New Generation REMUS 100 - 1.5 kWh.sensor_load_basis: The 12-h New Generation REMUS 100 evidence is tied to an MCM/sonar-equipped configuration; the field report confirms operation with the fitted sonar suite.
New Generation REMUS 100 - 1.5 kWh.source_note: New Generation REMUS 100: 1.5 kWh, 12 h at 3 kt. HII independently states up to 12 h for new REMUS 100 MCM vehicles equipped with side-scan sonar.

size_class: S = small-body/portable; M = torpedo-tube/medium-body; L = larger research/high-power vehicle. Modeling tag only; no multiplier is active.
